briefdescription.para: C implementation of AtomicMarkableReference in Java.

detaileddescription.para:
Addresses must be 4-byte-aligned in order to use vatomicptr_markable_t.
Extends vatomicptr_t to vatomicptr_markable_t. The LSB of the address is utilized as a mark.
